draft_en.subject: Beside the UTEPO switches you carry - two numbers and a 1 + 1 sample for your access-control sites
draft_en.body:
Hi Andreea,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 10 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Beside the UTEPO switches you carry with Dahua and ZKTeco, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; DIN-rail industrial 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, unmanaged, -40 to 75 C - STI-288GP - $60. Samples are paid at the same price and ship by courier.

One question: would a 1 + 1 sample to compare on your access-control sites be useful - and to which address?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
